name: @archally/brandvoice-schema
description: YAML-based schema for brand communication strategy modeling: market reality, brand strategy, activation, and governance
author: Adam Walkowski <adam.walkowski@inperceptic.com>

scripts.validate:examples: node tools/validator/src/cli.mjs examples/fitness-app/.brandvoice/v1.8 --schemas schema/v1.8 && node tools/validator/src/cli.mjs examples/time-management/.brandvoice/v1.8 --schemas schema/v1.8
scripts.check:examples: node tools/semantic-checker/dist/cli.js examples/fitness-app/.brandvoice/v1.8 && node tools/semantic-checker/dist/cli.js examples/time-management/.brandvoice/v1.8
scripts.test: vitest run --config tools/model-builder/vitest.config.ts && vitest run --config tools/semantic-checker/vitest.config.ts && node --test tools/validator/src/references.test.mjs tools/port/release-check.test.mjs
